- [EVENT] User received communion from Father John at the Mass attended on April 17th.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided information about the significance of St. Peter's Basilica, including:
  - Built on the site where Saint Peter is said to have been buried.
  - Largest Christian church in the world, with a capacity to hold over 60,000 worshippers.
  - Designed by Donato Bramante, Michelangelo, and Carlo Maderno.
  - Tomb of Saint Peter located beneath the basilica, believed to contain his remains.
  - Connection to the continuity of the Church and the martyrdom of Saint Peter.
  - Adorned with numerous works of art, including Michelangelo's Pieta.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained the significance of the washing of the feet ceremony during Holy Thursday, including:
  - Symbolizes Jesus' act of humility and love.
  - Originates from the Last Supper as described in the Gospel of John (13:1-15).
  - A reminder of true leadership being about serving others.
  - Integral part of the Holy Thursday liturgy.
- [EVENT] User attended a Holy Thursday service at St. Mary's Church recently.
